programmes.d: Philip Serrell and Natasha Raskin wind through Wales to Llanelli, Carmarthenshire.
Philip Serrell thinks "big is best" on his shopping trip with rival expert Thomas Plant as they journey from York to Rotherham in search of a bargain.
In Yorkshire Roo learns about Victorian loos while David gets very excited about a vintage watch. Two brooches and wooden cat all go under the gavel in Dundee.
Philip Serrell and Natasha Raskin cross into England and head to an auction in Gloucester.
Thomas Plant gets to ride in a special classic car and Philip Serrell has his eye on a unique lady, as they make their way through the Peak District.
Roo's head gets stuck in an antique while David buys a bull and an elephant. An eventful trip in Scotland ends with an ice cream and an Edinburgh auction.
Philip Serrell and Natasha Raskin shop in Hertfordshire, Oxfordshire and Buckinghamshire.
On the fourth leg of their road trip, Thomas Plant has a brush with showbiz and Philip Serrell takes a fancy to some gym equipment.
Natasha Raskin plays catch-up as she and Philip Serrell travel around Sussex and Kent.
A secret map once used by the RAF navigates David to potential profits while a fruity 350-year-old book gets Roo's attention. Who'll win the final auction in North Shields?
Experts Philip Serrell and Thomas Plant make some unlikely purchases on their last road trip and face a nail-biting finale at auction in Greenwich.
It’s the last day for Natasha Raskin and Philip Serrell. Who will win in Salisbury?
Newbie Irita Marriott brings Latvian flair to the game as she takes on Tim Medhurst in a sporting tour of the antiques emporia of Lincolnshire. One expert has a brush with the law.
It's the start of a new road trip as savvy antiques aficionados Mark Stacey and Paul Laidlaw pit their expertise against each other on their journey from Lancashire to Somerset.
Thomas Kent visits the world of Ramsgate. Mark Stacey gets a science lesson in Dover.
Tim and Irita's second trip. She's on top and in the Suffolk pink, while he has a bit of a break down before giving her a terrible fright. Will bidders love the sweetheart brooch?
Paul Laidlaw buys some nightmarish figures and Mark Stacey goes retro as the boys travel across the country in style on the second leg of their trip.
Mark Stacey is trailing, but can he catch Thomas Plant at auction in Paddock Wood?
On a journey through Bedfordshire that includes airships and tractors, Irita splashes her cash on fine silver while Tim goes for bargain basement. But who'll clean up at auction?
On the third leg of their road trip, Mark Stacey and Paul Laidlaw start their shopping in Stafford and finish with a nail-biting auction in Nantwich.
Thomas Plant and Mark Stacey shop in Essex and Suffolk, then on to a Cambridge auction.
Paul Laidlaw gets a peek into the life of the royals and Mark Stacey learns about Pomp and Circumstance on the fourth leg of their road trip.
Tim takes up West Country skittles while Irita spins a good sailing yarn at an historic Somerset twine works. Both buy pig themed antiques but who'll be trotting home the victor?
Thomas Plant learns of a nursing pioneer. Mark Stacey hears the tale of a lost Dunwich.
Two antiques experts Mark Stacey and Paul Laidlaw play with boats and helicopters as they storm towards the finishing line of this road trip.
A very old clock is ticking for Tim at Salisbury Cathedral on the last leg of his trip with Irita. She's currently out in front but could he become the tortoise to her hare?
With barely £30 between Mark Stacey and Thomas Plant, the heat is on at the final auction.

It's the start of a new road trip and antiques experts James Lewis and James Braxton kick off at Ampthill in Bedfordshire and head for Market Harborough with the popular hymn Amazing Grace ringing in their ears.
Catherine Southon and Paul Laidlaw begin with a bust up before the first auction at Omagh.
Antiques dealer Paul Martin makes his Road Trip debut alongside seasoned tripper Raj Bisram. A mysterious giant and very cute dog also feature in this South Downs adventure.
On the second leg of their trip James Braxton and James Lewis travel around Oxfordshire in their classic car in search of bargains to sell at auction.
Catherine Southon and Paul Laidlaw soak up the Irish scenery en route to Scotland.
The Road Trip continues in Wiltshire for debutant Paul Martin and seasoned chum Raj Bisram. Will a gamble buy of antique jelly moulds cause an auction wobble for one expert?
Roadtrippers James Braxton and James Lewis head south to the sunshine of Jersey and get a taste of Island life on the third leg of their journey.
Paul Laidlaw and Catherine Southon tour the Scottish Borders. Someone finds glove puppets.
Raj Bisram and Paul Martin explore antique shops in the West Country. At auction an expensive biscuit tin leaves a foul taste while a cheap oil painting makes an impression.
On the fourth leg of their trip James Braxton learns about Faversham's "explosive" history and his opponent James Lewis settles for a nice cup of tea.
Paul Laidlaw and Catherine Southon shop across central Scotland before auction in Kinbuck.
Antiques expert chums, Raj Bisram and Paul Martin take their open-topped motor to Dorset, Devon, Somerset and beyond. Will they make profits at the Worcestershire auction?
In the final dash for the finishing line experts James Braxton and James Lewis head for Leamington Spa in the hope of being crowned road trip winner.
Who will win the decisive battle between Catherine Southon and Paul Laidlaw in Aberdeen?
Anita Manning and Jonathan Pratt embark on a road trip that will take them on a 400-mile journey from Glasgow in Scotland to the Isle of Anglesey.
Raj Bisram and Paul Martin reach Shakespeare country, to buy or not to buy? Plus, they meet alpacas and do some ballet. Expect Incas, tutus and tights.
Anita Manning and Philip Serrell begin in the Lake District and head toward Blackpool.
Jonathan Pratt visits the world's first savings bank and Anita Manning gets some tips on marriage at Gretna Green on the second leg of their trip.
A new Road Trip sees Steven Moore find some pricey porcelain in an antique shop loo, while Natasha Raskin Sharp disappears down a secret tunnel on a journey back in time.
Anita Manning and Philip Serrell depart Barnard Castle with Anita in the lead.
Anita Manning and Jonathan Pratt drive from Middleham in Yorkshire through to Halifax in their classic car, looking to make a profit at auction.
Phil Serrell hopes Anita Manning will regret blowing her whole budget.
Northumberland sees Natasha on safari tracking ancient creatures while Steven finds an old elephant. Both experts go Georgian with their treasures going under the gavel in Dundee.
Anita Manning shows an unusual taste in sculpture and Jonathan Pratt opts for something very shapely as the experts head for north Wales.
Anita Manning's got some catching up to do as she and Phil Serrell embark from Amble.
Steven and Natasha visit the Scottish Borders. They reveal the hidden past of the Roman Empire and an antique hiding a secret. Expect more surprises at the Edinburgh auction.
On the last leg of their road trip Anita Manning and Jonathan Pratt head for Anglesey for their final auction showdown.
Anita Manning and Phil Serrell finish at a nail-biting final auction in the Lake District.
The Scottish antique buying adventure continues for Steven and Natasha. The pricey purchase of some militaria proves costly, and an unassuming lantern attracts big bids.
It's the start of a brand-new road trip and antiques experts David Harper and Catherine Southon journey through Lancashire heading for their first auction in the sea-faring city of Liverpool.
Christina Trevanion and Thomas Plant are hunting for treasure to auction in County Offaly.
A trip through Scotland sees Natasha get to grips with haggis and Steven falls for an exquisite French lady. It's the last auction of this adventure, who will take Road Trip crown?
David Harper goes to jail and Catherine Southon goes to church on the second leg of their antiques road trip through north Wales and Shropshire.
Christina Trevanion and Thomas Plant shop their way from Ireland to Wales.
A new adventure for Izzie Balmer and Philip Serrell, who scour the shops of Kent in search of antiques. Expect rocking horse riding, cat whispering and disagreements about scarves.
Experts David Harper and Catherine Southon go on a buying spree through mid-Wales on the third leg of their journey from Lancashire to Devon.
Twice-victorious Christina Trevanion and Thomas Plant continue their Welsh adventure.
David Harper brushes shoulders with a TV classic and Catherine Southon gets a taste for one of Gloucester's finest edibles as they head for auction.
Back on the road with Izzie Balmer and Phil Serrell as they hunt for elusive antique treasures. A gamble on some brown furniture may prove profitable at the Hertfordshire auction.
Christina Trevanion and Thomas Plant get treated to a fabulous Battle of Britain airshow.
Catherine Southon gets to dance and David Harper finds himself financially embarrassed as they head for a final auction showdown at Seaton in Devon.
Christina Trevanion and Thomas Plant shop the border counties of north Wales and England.
Izzie Balmer and Phil Serrell are driving through a downpour in Oxfordshire on the trail of treasures. Will a long-lost saucer or designer brooch most excite the Harrogate auction?
Charlie Ross and Charles Hanson join forces in a smart classic car for a 500-mile trip from Cheshire to Winchester on the first leg of their journey.
Charlie Ross set records the last time he toured with James Braxton. Can he do it again?
Gloves off and weapons at the ready as experts Izzie Balmer and Philip Serrell scour the shops of Staffordshire and Shropshire. But who will be left standing at the auction?
Charlie Ross goes cricket mad and his rival Charles Hanson goes to the pub and unearths some skulduggery as the pair takes their road trip from Chesterfield to Grantham.
Charlie Ross and James Braxton continue from their hunt from Stamford to St. Ives.
It's the final face-off for Izzie Balmer and Phil Serrell as they search the shops of Lincolnshire for bargains. A hefty horticultural item and delicate posy holder go to auction.
On the third leg of their road trip Charles Hanson visits the solicitors and Charlie Ross finds history in an old packet of cigarettes.
Charlie Ross and James Braxton meander from Shenton to the village of Bourne End.

Our two treasure seekers, in a 1963 Super Minx, are dealer Stephanie Connell and auctioneer Charlie Ross. They're having fun and chasing profits, from 'The Garden of England' at Sevenoaks through Folkestone.
Charles Hanson buys something he doesn't like and Charlie Ross profits from a most unlikely item en route to auction in Ledbury, Herefordshire.
